title: Are Current Task-oriented Dialogue Systems Able to Satisfy Impolite Users?
reasoning: The paper mentions politeness as a 'human virtue' but focuses on the practical challenge of dialogue systems handling impolite user utterances and improving their robustness. It does not delve into a deep evaluation or benchmarking of ethical or moral principles within the LLM's responses or the user's behavior beyond the scope of conversational etiquette.
